title: Break complex thoughts into short sentences
name: One idea per sentence
syntax: Ich kann heute nicht kommen. Ich bin krank.
summary: The simplest way to avoid difficult subordinate clauses.
rule: Prefer two clear independent sentences to a sentence involving weil, dass, obwohl, or relative clauses.
examples: Ich kann heute nicht kommen. Ich bin krank.
I cannot come today. I am sick.
Ich brauche Hilfe. Ich verstehe das Formular nicht.
I need help. I do not understand the form.
Ich habe eine Frage. Haben Sie kurz Zeit?
I have a question. Do you have a moment?
avoid: “Short and clear” does not mean omitting the verb. Keep German verb order intact.
note: Later you can join ideas with denn (because) or more advanced subordinate clauses.
